mandatory_legal_checks: Companies Act 2013 S.62(1)(b) and SCD Rules R.12 — scheme must be approved by shareholders; check the MCA private-company exemption of 5 June 2015 before relying on an ordinary resolution
SCD Rules R.12(6)(a) — MINIMUM one year between grant and vesting; no vesting date may fall inside the first year
SCD Rules R.12(8)(a)-(b) — options are non-transferable and cannot be pledged or encumbered
SCD Rules R.12(8)(d) — on death, unvested options VEST in the legal heirs; they do not lapse
SCD Rules R.12(8)(e) — on permanent incapacity, unvested options vest that day
SCD Rules R.12(8)(f) — on resignation or termination, unvested options expire; vested options remain exercisable
Income-tax Act S.17(2)(vi) — tax arises on EXERCISE, not on sale; the employee may owe tax on a gain they cannot realise
Income-tax Act S.192(1C) — deferral available only to an eligible start-up under S.80-IAC; confirm eligibility before promising it
SCD Rules R.12 — eligibility restrictions on promoters and on directors holding more than 10 per cent
